Counsel for Applicant :- Dharm Trivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.460 of 2014, under Sections 376, 302, 34 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Mitauli, District Kheri.
3. This is the second bail application.
The first bail application was rejected vide order dated 19.10.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8479 of 2022 with directions to conclude trial within a period of one year.

4. In terms of the FIR, the allegations were levelled against two persons including the applicant of having committed rape and committed the murder of a 14 years old girl.
This Court while rejecting the first bail application had noticed the injuries which are serious in nature.

5. The Counsel for the applicant argues that there are no eyewitness of the incident, however, the applicant was implicated based upon the statement of two witnesses who had seen three persons running out of the field where the body was found.

It is further argued that one of the accused Ram Gopal against whom a similar statement was given enlarged was enlarged on bail vide order dated 06.15.2015 passed in Bail No.1527 of 2015 and the applicant continued to be in detention since 27.11.2014.
6.
He further argues that out of 14 witnesses, only 6 witnesses have been examined so far.

Although the allegations against the applicant are serious, however, this Court cannot lose sight of the fact that pretrial detention of almost 10 years, prima facie, violates the rights as enshrined under Article 21 of the Constitution of India.
7. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

8. Considering the prolonged pretrial detention and the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and only 6 witnesses out of 14 witnesses have been examined so far, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant Sultana alias Anil Kumar Pasi be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.7.2024 akverma  Sultana Alias Anil Kumar Pasi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
